title: Floquet-spin-orbit compensation and flat- and quadratic-band contact in the $α$-$T_3$ lattice
summary: We investigate Floquet--spin-orbit compensation in the three-band $α$-$T_3$ system, which interpolates between graphene at $α=0$ and the dice lattice at $α=1$. By tuning the interplay between an off-resonant circularly polarized optical field and intrinsic spin--orbit coupling, we identify three distinct pairwise band-degeneracy conditions in the quasienergy spectrum: (i) valley--spin degeneracy, (ii) spin--band degeneracy, and (iii) flat--dispersive band degeneracy.
